name: Mara
intro: Salve, viator. I'm Mara. Some words here are older than the road.
Salve, viator. Herba in horto crescit. You are learning to see the vale.
Salve, viator. Verba movent mundum. You are learning what the words can do.

reply: Salve! That is how we greet a traveler.
Salve, viator. A greeting is a beginning, not a spell.
Salve. The words sound more natural every time you use them.

text: Ubi est silva? (Where is the forest?)
reply: The old trees grow past the western creek. Follow the water.
Silva est trans rivum. The forest is across the stream.
Silva est trans rivum. But not everything between its trees is a tree.

text: Quid herbam iuvat? (What helps the plant?)
reply: Aqua herbam iuvat. Water helps the plant.
Aqua herbam iuvat. You understood the book.
Aqua herbam iuvat. The same knowledge nourishes magic.
choices.locked: Read De Herbis first. Then we can speak about what you learned.

name: Tomas
intro: Salve. I keep the books near the crooked cottage. A herb might be worth a lesson.
Salve. Liber in domo est. I keep the books in the house.
Salve, discipule. In libris scientia est. Knowledge lives in books.

reply: Salve. Don't be afraid of making a mistake in front of a book.
Salve, discipule. You have been reading.
Salve. Even a scholar must sometimes begin again.

text: Trade one herb for a Latin book.
Herbam pro libro. (One herb for a book.)
reply: Take De Igne et Aqua. A book for the herb; a fair exchange.
Tene librum. Aqua ignem exstinguit. Water puts out fire.
choices.locked: Bring me one herb. I'll exchange it for De Igne et Aqua.
choices.already_owned: You already carry De Igne et Aqua. Read it before seeking more.
choices.already_traded: We made our exchange. The rest you must discover yourself.

text: Can I build a place of my own?
Ubi est turris? (Where is the tower?)
reply: The broken priory lies along the southern road. There is room enough in this vale.
Turris vetus prope ruinas est. An old tower stands near the ruins.
Turris vetus prope ruinas est. A new tower will take more than words.
